footer.about: Dan Dan The Window Man is an owner-run exterior remodeling company on West Kellogg Drive in Wichita. We replace windows and doors, install vinyl siding and gutters, and handle hail damage claims.
why: Owner Rick Timsah works with you himself
Free estimates on windows, doors and siding
Your customers say the same things: Rick is easy to work with, the installers finish fast and clean up, and the price is fair. On Google you hold a 4.7 across 44 reviews.
Your current site splits its top headline between windows and hail roofing, runs its menu off the edge of a phone, and never names Rick.
So we rebuilt it around what your customers already say: an owner who answers straight, and a crew that leaves the house clean.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and how the demo fixes it.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: On a phone the page is twice as wide as the screen. Your number and the Roofing, Financing, Reviews and Let's Talk buttons sit past the edge.
The top of the page is three headlines: windows and siding, hail roofing claims, and Wichita. Google can't tell whether you are a window company or a roofer.
"Here's what our customers are saying..." has no reviews under it, and nothing on the page names Rick.
fixes: Your number is one tap from the top of every page, with the whole menu on screen.
A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Rick named as the owner, with real reviews beside each point.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Windows are about three quarters of your written reviews, and the page that sells them is short.
problems: The Windows page is two paragraphs, a feature list and two PDF buttons, with no customer review and nothing on install day, which is what your reviewers praise.
fixes: A full page for window replacement in Wichita, KS.
Styles, glass, install steps and payment, each beside a real review.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Doors & Siding
cards.why: Your reviewers describe door and siding jobs, and your site gives them a paragraph and a list of names.
problems: The Siding page lists eight product names with no description under any of them.
Gutters, which customers ask for, appear only as a box on the contact form.
fixes: One page for doors and siding in Wichita.
Gutters named, with a review from your own customers.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: The page where interest turns into a call.
problems: Your site says 10 to 5 and your Birdeye profile says 8 to 5, so a customer can't tell when to call.
Nothing says which number is for roofing and which is for windows.
fixes: Both numbers one tap, each labeled with what it is for.
A page that says what to have ready before you call.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.
